## 04 – Deployment Correlation (owner: Tharindu)
Commits + GitHub Actions runs before the incident. "Suspect" = within `DEPLOY_SUSPECT_MINUTES`. Correlation is a **possible** cause, never a confirmed one.

nodes.name: GitHub API
nodes.notes: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits and /actions/runs. Credential: fine-grained token, read-only.
